mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in CPIAUCSL above 3% for three consecutive months signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 exceeding 2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and depresses equity prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation, prompting tighter monetary policy and ultimately negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in FEDFUNDS and a decline in RSAFS over two months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises and RSAFS falls for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and GDPC1 above their respective 6-month moving averages signals strengthening housing demand and overall economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals robust labor market growth, which supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for more than six consecutive months, monetary policy is accommodative, lowering borrowing costs and supporting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.
